#SCUMMING
##Data import and preparation
```{r}
library(compositions)
library(zCompositions)
library(readxl)
scumming <- read_excel("George_EDX_interpretat.xlsx", sheet = "Scumming")

library(tidyverse)
d_scm <- scumming |> 
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sample") |> 
  cmultRepl(method = "CZM") |> 
  clr() |> 
  as.data.frame() 
  
```

##Exploratory PCA
```{r}

library(factoextra)
library(FactoMineR)

pca_res_scm <- PCA(d_scm, graph = F)

fviz_pca_biplot(pca_res_scm,
                repel = T)



```
